cards.name: Free Vector
cards.rulesText: When Free Vector dies, draw a card.

cards.name: Intersentinel
cards.rulesText:
At the beginning of each level, your Boss heals 1.

Response {One Cost}{Tap} : Block (A Boss or Fighter attacks this Fighter instead.)

rulings.text: You cannot heal past printed health

cards.name: Eff with me Ammo
cards.rulesText:
Eff with me Ammo has Agility as long as you have a Rat on your team.

{Two Cost}{Tap}: Create a Mystic Fighter Rat token named "Head Rat" with 2 Health, 0 Attack Cost, and 1 Attack.

rulings.text: Tokens are not returned to hand or sent to discard, nor can they be 'linked' to another card.  They leave play when they are destroyed.

cards.name: Mother May Eye
cards.rulesText:
Mother May Eye gets +1 Attack for each Tactic or Response card you've played this level.

{Tap}: For the rest of this level, play with the top card of your deck revealed. You may play Tactic or Response cards from the top of your deck.
If you've played 3 or more Tactic or Response cards this level, she gains Agility this level.

rulings.text: Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.

cards.name: Tantrum
cards.subtitle: World Ender
cards.rulesText:
Tantrum can't be attacked as long as you have Whump! on your team.

{Three Cost}{Tap}, Deal 1 damage to Tantrum: Create a Mystic Fighter token named "Whump!" with 4 Health, 1 Attack Cost, and 3 Attack. It dies at the end of the level.

rulings.text: Tokens are not returned to hand or sent to discard, nor can they be 'linked' to another card.  They leave play when they are destroyed.

cards.name: Eliza
cards.subtitle: Do Little
cards.rulesText: Eliza gets +2 Attack as long as you have a Shifter on your team.

cards.name: Shadowcaster
cards.rulesText:
Enforcer (This must always be attacked before another Boss or Fighter on your team if able.)

{One Cost}: Phantasmal (If he isn't Phantasmal, put a +1 Attack counter on him and he becomes Phantasmal.)

rulings.text: Phantasmal is a status and a technique, and is not a Trait.
You can not activate ability to gain Phantasmal if the Fighter is already Phantasmal.

cards.name: Yoshi
cards.subtitle: Victory at all Cost
cards.rulesText:
Stealthy (It can't be attacked the level it enters play.)

Yoshi gets +1 Attack when attacking Synths.
{Two Cost}{Tap}, Destroy Yoshi: Destroy target Synth Fighter.

cards.name: Dette
cards.subtitle: Quickener
cards.rulesText:
When Dette becomes Phantasmal, target Fighter on your team gains 2 Health.

{One Cost}: Phantasmal (If she isn't Phantasmal, put a +1 Attack counter on her and she becomes Phantasmal.)

rulings.text: Phantasmal is a status and a technique, and is not a Trait.
You can not activate ability to gain Phantasmal if the Fighter is already Phantasmal.

cards.name: Diffin
cards.subtitle: Slow Hand
cards.rulesText:
Diffin can't attack unless you have a Fighter with 5 or more Health on your team.

Response {One Cost}{Tap} : Block (A Boss or Fighter attacks this Fighter instead.)

cards.name: Ebb
cards.subtitle: Balancer of Scales
cards.rulesText:
When Ebb enters play, you may add a counter to a Boss or Fighter on your team of a type it already has or remove a counter from target Boss or Fighter on your team.

Ebb gets +1 Attack as long as a Boss or Fighter on your team has a counter on it.

cards.name: Gates
cards.subtitle: Supportive Sensei
cards.rulesText: When Gates enters play, another target Boss or Fighter gets +2 Attack this level.

cards.name: Knap
cards.subtitle: Forgemaster
cards.rulesText: Response {Two Cost}{Tap} : Unwield target Weapon from a Fighter. If it is your Weapon, draw a card.

cards.name: Mist Me
cards.rulesText:
Stealthy (It can't be attacked the level it enters play.)

{One Cost}: Phantasmal (If it isn't Phantasmal, put a +1 Attack counter on it and it becomes Phantasmal.)

rulings.text: Phantasmal is a status and a technique, and is not a Trait.
You can not activate ability to gain Phantasmal if the Fighter is already Phantasmal.

cards.name: Bleargh
cards.subtitle: Noxious Entity
cards.rulesText: Hot Mike sez: “Some people can smell trouble when it enters the station. EVERYONE can smell when Bleargh! enters the station.”

cards.name: Flecks
cards.subtitle: Accelerator
cards.rulesText:
When Flecks enters play, the base Attack Cost of target Fighter becomes {One Cost} this level.

{One Cost}{Tap}: The base Attack Cost of target Boss or Fighter becomes {One Cost} this level.

rulings.text: Fleck's ability to make a fighter's attack cost one over-rides Muck's printed cost of "equal to his Health" allowing Muck to attack for one token.

cards.name: Reika
cards.subtitle: First Novice
cards.rulesText:
Armor 1 (Prevent the first 1 damage each level that would be dealt to this.)

Response {Tap} : Block (A Boss or Fighter attacks this Fighter instead.)

cards.name: Shaman of Eternity
cards.rulesText:
Whenever you place one or more +1 Attack counters on a Boss or Fighter on your team, draw a card.

{Two Cost}: Phantasmal (If he isn't Phantasmal, put a +1 Attack counter on him and he becomes Phantasmal.)

rulings.text: Phantasmal is a status and a technique, and is not a Trait.

Shaman of Eternity will draw a card for each Boss or Fighter given a +1 Attack counter, even in a case like Roll Call where you may be putting a +1 Attack counter on up to five Fighters simultaneously.
You can not activate ability to gain Phantasmal if the Fighter is already Phantasmal.

cards.name: Tyro
cards.subtitle: Sensei's Pet
cards.rulesText:
Determination (If he would die and he doesn't have a +1 Attack counter, instead set him to 1 Health and give him a +1 Attack counter.)

Response {Two Cost}{Tap} : Another target Boss or Fighter heals 2.

cards.name: Axel
cards.subtitle: Deathracer
cards.rulesText:
As long as Axel is Phantasmal, he has Agility. (Can tap twice per level.)

{One Cost}: Phantasmal (If he isn't Phantasmal, put a +1 Attack counter on him and he becomes Phantasmal.)

rulings.text: Phantasmal is a status and a technique, and is not a Trait.
You can not activate ability to gain Phantasmal if the Fighter is already Phantasmal.

cards.name: Luna
cards.subtitle: Rage Vessel
cards.rulesText: Hot Mike sez: “Everyone gives her a pass on her attitude. Symbiotically bonded with a rage entity blah blah blah. I have known her since before that and, if you ask me, the entity calmed her down.”

cards.name: Stat
cards.subtitle: Mirage Master
cards.rulesText: Stat enters play as a copy of another Fighter, except it still has Stat's name, Attack Cost, and Attack.

rulings.text: If Stat, Mirage Master copies a fighter, it puts its own name in all places the card it copies uses its own name, such as Gizzard, Persistent Pest's "You can have any number of copies of Gizzard on your team," and thus until the Stat/Gizzard copy dies, you can have any number of Stats in play, even that are not copying Gizzard.  Once the Stat/Gizzard copy dies, all other Stats will resolve the "one in play"  immediately.

cards.name: Sage
cards.subtitle: Fair Fighter
cards.rulesText:
When Sage enters play, destroy up to one target Weapon. Sage gains Health equal to the level of that weapon.

When Sage attacks, roll a six-sided die. If you roll 4 or higher, Sage gets +1 Attack this level and roll again.

cards.name: Shadowstriker
cards.rulesText: Shadowstriker can't be blocked and can attack as though opposing Fighters do not have Enforcer.

cards.name: DeeLux
cards.subtitle: Brutal Savant
cards.rulesText: {Two Cost}{Tap}: Target Fighter on your team gets a +1 Attack counter. That Fighter gains one of the following abilities this level: Agility, Determination, or Enforcer.

cards.name: Clief
cards.subtitle: Ancient Eclipse
cards.rulesText: When Clief attacks, you may play a Tactic card from your discard pile without paying its cost. Put that card on the bottom of your deck.

rulings.text: This card will have text that clarifies that the Tactic played from discard will go on the bottom of the player's deck.

cards.name: Echo Fade
cards.rulesText: Put two -1 Attack counters on target Fighter.

rulings.text: -1 Attack Counters and +1 Attack Counters obliterate eachother. However,  if a +1 attack counter is placed on a Mahna that already has -1 attack counters on it, Mahna does 'see' the enhancement and draw a card (if she has not drawn already).

cards.name: Evanesce
cards.rulesText:
Destroy up to one target Weapon.

Draw a card.

cards.name: Full Heal!
cards.rulesText: Heal all Fighters on your team to their maximum Health.

cards.name: RATS!
cards.rulesText: Put a +1 Attack counter on up to three target Fighters on your team.

rulings.text: Shaman of Eternity will draw a card for each Boss or Fighter given a +1 Attack counter, even in a case like Roll Call where you may be putting a +1 Attack counter on up to five Fighters simultaneously.

cards.name: Sludged
cards.rulesText: Put target attacking Fighter on top of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Malefice
cards.rulesText: Destroy target Weapon. If it is wielded by a Fighter, deal damage to that Fighter equal to the Weapon's level.

cards.name: Roll Call
cards.rulesText:
Choose one:

- Distribute up to five +1 Attack counters among Fighters on your team.
- Draw a card for each Fighter with a counter on it on your team.

rulings.text: Shaman of Eternity will draw a card for each Boss or Fighter given a +1 Attack counter, even in a case like Roll Call where you may be putting a +1 Attack counter on up to five Fighters simultaneously.

cards.name: Theurgic Thrashing
cards.rulesText:
Deal 3 damage to target Fighter.

Target Boss or Fighter heals 3. (Healing can't exceed maximum Health.)

cards.name: Voltage Snap
cards.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to target Boss or Fighter. If it's a Synth or Survivor, deal 3 damage instead.

cards.name: Head Rat
cards.rulesText: Hot Mike sez: “Sometimes? In the middle of the night I can hear their whiskers rustling in the tunnels, like they are saying something. I can almost grok it but then my screams drown them out.”

cards.name: Whump!
cards.rulesText: Whump! dies at the end of the level.

cards.name: Dog-Eared Passage
cards.rulesText:
(Weapons enter wielded to a Fighter.)

When Dog-Eared Passage becomes wielded, the wielder gains Stealthy this level. (The wielder can't be attacked for the rest of this level.)
Whenever the wielder attacks, draw a card.

rulings.text: Stealth can be re-aquired on future Levels, and doing so will make it regain the ability to not be attacked that Level.
If a unit gains Stealth while an attack on the line is targeting it (for example, with Autopilot + Dog-Eared Passage), the attack will fail/fizzle as it is no longer a legal target.

cards.name: Effin' Slingshot
cards.rulesText:
(Weapons enter wielded to a Fighter.)

Reduce the wielder's Attack Cost by {One Cost}.

cards.name: Gauntlet of the Dead
cards.rulesText:
(Weapons enter wielded to a Fighter.)

When the wielder attacks, reveal the top card of your deck.
You may play that card this level for its cost or if the level requirement is met. If you don't, put a +1 Attack counter on the wielder and you may put the revealed card in your discard pile.

rulings.text: Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.
The revealed card must be played as appropriate to the card type timing.

The revealed card is available until the end of level as long as it remains on top of the deck, at the end of the level a delayed trigger occurs, and if no card is revealed, the originally wielded unit is granted a +1 attack token.  Wording changing incoming to clarify

cards.name: Sword from Nowhere
cards.rulesText:
(Weapons enter wielded to a Fighter.)

The wielder gets +X Attack equal to the number of Tactic and Response cards in your discard pile.
{Two Cost}, Destroy Sword from Nowhere: Return a Tactic or Response card from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Whiskers of the Ancient
cards.rulesText:
(Weapons enter wielded to a Fighter.)

When the wielder attacks, it becomes the Faction of your choice for the rest of this level.
The wielder gets +1 Attack for each Faction among your Boss and Fighters on your team.

rulings.text: If you change a fighter's faction to Synth (e.g. with Whiskers of the Ancient), it becomes an eligible target for Fortify.  If it later changes back to it's original faction, the fortification *stays* on; fortification only matters when being attached.

cards.name: Charlotte
cards.subtitle: Nightbringer
cards.rulesText:
When Charlotte defeats a Fighter, you may remove that Fighter from play linked to Charlotte. Only one Fighter can be removed at a time this way. If the linked Fighter is replaced, put it in its owner's discard pile.

Charlotte has all activated abilities of the linked Fighter and adds its Attack to her base Attack.

rulings.text: Tokens are not returned to hand or sent to discard, nor can they be 'linked' to another card.  They leave play when they are destroyed.

cards.name: Seeya
cards.subtitle: Later Gator
cards.rulesText:
Seeya can't be attacked if you have 5 or more Fighters on your team.

The first time Seeya is attacked each level, reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a Fighter, put it into your hand.

rulings.text: Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.

cards.name: Tryp
cards.subtitle: Timelost
cards.rulesText:
Whenever you discard one or more cards, Tryp deals 1 damage to all opposing Bosses and Fighters.

When Tryp attacks, you may discard a card.

cards.name: Clatter
cards.subtitle: Cornered
cards.rulesText:
When Clatter is dealt damage by an attack, he deals 1 damage to the attacking Boss or Fighter.

Response {One Cost}{Tap} : Block (A Boss or Fighter attacks this Fighter instead.)

cards.name: Kupp Lightpaws
cards.rulesText:
When Kupp enters play, choose an opponent. That opponent discards a card.

{Two Cost}: Transform (Destroy this Fighter. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Fighter of that level or lower with a different name and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.)

rulings.text: You only shuffle your Discard and return it as your deck when you are told to draw a card and cannot.  Reveal effects cannot cause this.
Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.
'Revealing  until' does not mean that as you go down the top card changes.

cards.name: Murder Countess
cards.rulesText: When Murder Countess enters play, deal 1 damage to up to two different target Bosses or Fighters.

cards.name: Oriana
cards.subtitle: Cutthroat
cards.rulesText: Whenever a player discards one or more cards, Oriana deals 1 damage to target Boss or Fighter.

cards.name: Burgess
cards.subtitle: Burrower Beneath
cards.rulesText: Hot Mike sez: “There are piles of rubble taller than this dude. And he made those piles to hide behind. Watch your ankles!”

cards.name: Coney
cards.subtitle: Toothfighter
cards.rulesText:
Armor 1 (Prevent the first 1 damage each level that would be dealt to this.)

When Coney enters play, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. If a Fighter was discarded this way, put a +1 Attack counter on Coney.

cards.name: Goodstead
cards.subtitle: Sandhog
cards.rulesText: Whenever a Fighter dies, put a +1 Attack counter on Goodstead.

rulings.text: Died and Destroyed are the same.  For example, destroying a fighter with Push does trigger Goodstead's ability.

cards.name: Phern
cards.subtitle: Battle Ready
cards.rulesText: When Phern enters play, look at the top four cards of your deck. You may reveal a Tactic or Response card with cost 3 or lower and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in a random order. If you don't, put a +1 Attack counter on Phern.

rulings.text: Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.
Effects that say "Look at" are NOT the same as Reveal and do not trigger Reveal effects, even if it further goes on to say you must reveal some of those "looked at" cards.

cards.name: Vermingus
cards.subtitle: Brutal Busker
cards.rulesText:
Whenever a Fighter enters play from your deck, Vermingus gains a +1 Attack counter and 1 Health.

{Two Cost}{Tap}: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Fighter that could be played this level, it enters play if it's not already on your team. Otherwise, put it into your hand.

rulings.text: Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.

cards.name: Gizzard
cards.subtitle: Persistent Pest
cards.rulesText:
You can have any number of copies of Gizzard, Persistent Pest on your team.

Gizzard, Persistent Pest gets +1 Attack for each other Fighter that shares a name with it in play.
Response {Tap} : Block (A Boss or Fighter attacks this Fighter instead.)

rulings.text: He now says "Gizzard, Persistent Pest gets +1 Attack for each other Pigeon in play."
His type has changed from "Fighter * The Shambles" to "Fighter * Pigeon"

If Stat, Mirage Master copies a fighter, it puts its own name in all places the card it copies uses its own name, such as Gizzard, Persistent Pest's "You can have any number of copies of Gizzard on your team," and thus until the Stat/Gizzard copy dies, you can have any number of Stats in play, even that are not copying Gizzard.  Once the Stat/Gizzard copy dies, all other Stats will resolve the "one in play"  immediately.

cards.name: Ryle
cards.subtitle: Unchecked
cards.rulesText:
When Ryle is dealt damage, deal that much damage to target Boss or Fighter.

When Ryle deals attack damage, deal 2 damage to Ryle.

cards.name: Vigo the Sharp
cards.rulesText: Vigo gets +1 Attack for each player that discarded a card this level.

rulings.text: Vigo does not need to have been in play when the cards were discarded to benefit from them.

cards.name: Darby
cards.subtitle: Straphanger
cards.rulesText: Hot Mike sez: “Nope! Not gonna talk smack about Darby. She finds all the best old comic books and doesn’t let anyone use them for … you know. Darby’s the best!”

cards.name: Gordo
cards.subtitle: Collector
cards.rulesText: When Gordo enters play, if a Fighter on your team died this level, deal 2 damage to target Boss or Fighter.

cards.name: Joe Strummage
cards.rulesText:
When Joe enters play, each player discards a card.

Joe can only attack if you have one or fewer cards in hand.

cards.name: Mumbly Peg
cards.rulesText: When Mumbly Peg enters play, choose an opponent. That opponent discards a card.

cards.name: Orson
cards.subtitle: Quickstinger
cards.rulesText:
When Orson enters play, stun target Fighter. (Stunned Fighters can't tap or activate abilities this level.)

{Two Cost}: Transform (Destroy this Fighter. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Fighter of that level or lower with a different name and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.)

rulings.text: You only shuffle your Discard and return it as your deck when you are told to draw a card and cannot.  Reveal effects cannot cause this.
Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.
'Revealing  until' does not mean that as you go down the top card changes.
Stun is always for the current level unless otherwise stated.  Stun does override Agility.

cards.name: Galen
cards.subtitle: Nurturer
cards.rulesText:
When Galen enters play, target Boss or Fighter heals 2.

{Two Cost}: Transform (Destroy this Fighter. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Fighter with that level or lower than the transformed Fighter with a different name and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.)

Revealing cards does not change the order of your cards or change what is the top card.
'Revealing  until' does not mean that as you go down the top card changes.
You cannot heal past printed health

cards.name: Slider
cards.subtitle: Untombed
cards.rulesText:
Determination

Slider has all Traits of all opposing Fighters.
Slider's Attack is equal to the number of unique Traits he has.

rulings.text: Phantasmal is a status and a technique, and is not a Trait.
Stealth can be re-aquired on future Levels, and doing so will make it regain the ability to not be attacked that Level.
If Stat, Mirage Master copies Slider, Untombed, he copies Slider's text - this causes his attack value to be equal to the number of unique Traits he has.
The traits are: Armor, Determination, Agility, Enforcer, Stealthy

cards.name: Minka
cards.subtitle: Underestimated
cards.rulesText:
Whenever a Fighter dies, put a +1 Attack counter on Minka.

Response {One Cost}{Tap} : Block (A Boss or Fighter attacks this Fighter instead.)

cards.name: Muck
cards.subtitle: Relentless Foe
cards.rulesText:
When Muck defeats a Fighter, he heals 1.

Muck's Attack Cost and Attack are equal to his Health.

rulings.text: Fleck's ability to make a fighter's attack cost one over-rides Muck's printed cost of "equal to his Health" allowing Muck to attack for one token.

cards.name: Pilskin
cards.subtitle: Slithering Striker
cards.rulesText:
When Pilskin enters play, stun up to two target Fighters. (Stunned Fighters can't tap or activate abilities this level.)

When Pilskin deals attack damage, he deals that much damage to another target Boss or Fighter.

rulings.text: Stun is always for the current level unless otherwise stated.  Stun does override Agility.

cards.name: Aha!
cards.rulesText:
Discard a card.

Draw two cards.

rulings.text: You attempt to fulfill as much of a card as possible.  If you are told to Reveal four cards with two cards remaining, you Reveal two cards.  If you are told to discard a card and then to draw two cards, but have no cards in hand, you still draw two cards despite being unable to discard a card.

cards.name: Catch!
cards.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to target Fighter.

cards.name: Derail
cards.rulesText: Destroy all Fighters.

cards.rulesText: Destroy target Level 2 or lower Fighter.

cards.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to up to two different target Bosses or Fighters.

All Bosses and Fighters can be attacked as though they don't have Stealthy this level.

Draw a card.

cards.name: Tracker's Frenzy
cards.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to target Boss or Fighter. If a Fighter left play this level, deal 3 damage instead.

cards.name: Undertowed
cards.rulesText: Destroy target Fighter with 4 or more Health.

cards.name: Marrowpiercer
cards.rulesText:
(Weapons enter wielded to a Fighter.)

Whenever the wielder deals attack damage, the wielder or your Boss heals equal to the attack damage dealt. (Healing can't exceed maximum Health.)

rulings.text: Damage dealt is not limited to current health of the defender.  "Overkill damage" will still provide healing.
When Marrowpiercer triggers, Marrowpiercer is the source of the healing.

cards.rulesText: Hot Mike sez: “The Heralds? So far down they're not even on the subway map. Real low class.”

When Kat deals attack damage, she deals that much damage to another target Boss or Fighter.

rulings.text:
Effects that Gain Life can go above printed health.  Effects that Heal cannot.  Gaining Life above the printed life does not change the level to which a fighter can be Healed (printed on card).  An example: a Boss with 16 printed health taking one damage (15) then Gain Life for three to 18.  then they take three damage dropping to 15 again, and being targeted with a Heal three, going only one as the max printed health is 16.
EXCEPTION:  Fortification allows healing past printed maximum health.

When a fighter's health goes above their printed maximum, they are not considered "enhanced" and this is not an "enhancement" (unless they are Fortified, which is an enhancement).  Therefore, cards like Boom! cannot use a "+1 Health counter" to deal extra damage as there is no such thing.

cards.name: Ada
cards.subtitle: Relict Fighter
cards.rulesText:
Ada gets +1 Attack for each enhanced Boss and Fighter on your team.

Response {Two Cost} : Fortify (This ability can be used from your hand on a Synth that isn't Fortified. Place this card under a Synth Boss or Fighter on your team. That Synth gains Health equal to this Fighter's Health.)

rulings.text: The temporary hit points from Fortification are always the last lost.  Hence if a fighter had five health, fortified three more to reach eight, then took six damage, if it lost the Fortification, it would be destroyed.  No amount of damage removes Fortification (short of the fighter's destruction).

Fortifications do not count as fighters.  As such, they do not trigger the "one name in play" rule.  Therefore, a fighter like Pia, Laser Focused or Ada, Relict Fighter can be a Fortification on a fighter or boss and you can still put a fighter of the same name into play.  Also, the Pia that is a Fortification does not count for purposes of "number of fighters and/or bosses in play" for cards that care about that number.

If you change a fighter's faction to Synth (e.g. with Whiskers of the Ancient), it becomes an eligible target for Fortify.  If it later changes back to it's original faction, the fortification *stays* on; fortification only matters when being attached.
